meta_description:
486K likes, 16K comments - scoutop on October 10, 2026: "Week 5 started with one beautiful moment , Scout receiving that one photo. The excitement, the smile, showing it to everyone, and keeping it close… moments like these reminded us of the person he truly is.

Then came the wave of selectively edited clips and negativity , painting a negative picture that those watching the live feeds know isn’t the truth . But we’ve seen the full journey since first week - the sibling bond, the laughter, and the genuine conversations that tell the real story.

When negativity got louder, #ScoutArmy made sure our support  was louder. Thank you to everyone who chose understanding over assumptions and truth over trends. Every comment, every post, every message and every bit of support reminded Scout that he isn’t standing alone. ❤️

#ScoutOP #BB20 #BiggBoss20".
